lens: Prospective client — ambiguous result; simulated intended-user lens, not a human participant
reason: The offer is understandable: student consulting, no consulting fee, a semester, 6–8 members, shared scoping and a responsive client contact. The supplied desktop hero and mobile capture show a coherent Precision Instrument identity and visible project actions. I traced the actual /work → /contact#message journey through source and its passing synthetic test, not through observed client use. However, uncertain inquiry outcomes are presented as definite failure, while unvalidated successful responses clear the message. Organization names establish breadth but the available site still cannot demonstrate the quality of a delivered recommendation. These gaps prevent world-class acceptance from this client lens; the hold concerns inquiry reliability and evidence, not an assertion that every public route is broken.

findings.evidence: submit(), lines 24–35: every HTTP success resets the form without requiring result.ok === true; a fetch exception states “Your message could not be sent.” src/lib/email.ts:62–95 can time out after provider acceptance; src/app/api/contact/route.ts:39–52 supplies no idempotency key and collapses delivery uncertainty into a 502. tests/e2e/public-journeys.spec.ts:39–52 intercepts only a valid 200 receipt.
findings.userImpact: A client can retry an already accepted inquiry, or lose their composed inquiry after a malformed successful response. The interface gives certainty it does not possess.
findings.suggestedFix: Validate the success receipt before clearing fields. Preserve the inquiry on malformed or uncertain responses, explain that delivery could not be confirmed, and use a stable request identity/provider idempotency key for safe retries. Add focused interrupted, timeout and malformed-receipt checks.

findings.evidence: ClientProjectGrid selected-client-profile renders organization descriptions and explicitly says scope, methods, deliverables and outcomes are pending approval. home/page.tsx:78–80 likewise shows pending case studies; work/page.tsx:56–63 omits selected work when no public projects exist. release-open-items.md confirms actual project artifacts remain absent.
findings.userImpact: A client can understand the proposed process but cannot inspect the reasoning or usefulness of prior MECG work before committing time and access. Logos alone do not establish recommendation quality.
findings.suggestedFix: Obtain approval for at least one concise engagement showing the decision, methods, deliverable excerpt and limitations. Keep pending disclosures until approval; do not invent results or expose confidential material.

notVerified: No hosted/staging contact delivery, provider acceptance, mailbox receipt, response-time performance or retry behavior was exercised; the supplied passing browser journey uses an intercepted API.
No real client task success, comprehension, trust or conversion study exists. Source and captures are not observed user success.
Client publication approvals, real deliverable quality and operational ability to honor the one-week reply and NDA statements were not independently established.
Contact/work visual captures, assistive technology, physical devices, Safari/Firefox and authenticated workflows were not verified in this seat.
